text: 据湖南日报，10月26日，记者从湖南省发改委获悉，《湖南省“十五五”循环经济发展规划》已于近日发布。其中明确，到2030年，湖南覆盖生产、消费、回收、利用全链条的现代化循环经济体系将更加完善，资源循环利用产业产值达到4000亿元。城市生活垃圾分类实现全覆盖，城市生活垃圾资源化利用率力争达到76%以上。
text_en: According to Hunan Daily, on October 26, reporters learned from the Hunan Provincial Development and Reform Commission that the "Hunan Province 15th Five-Year Plan for Circular Economy Development" was released recently. It specifies that by 2030, Hunan's modern circular economy system covering the entire chain of production, consumption, recycling and utilization will be more complete, and the output value of the resource recycling industry will reach 400 billion yuan. Urban household waste sorting will achieve full coverage, and the resource utilization rate of urban household waste will strive to reach more than 76%.
